description: Phrases that must NOT appear in the production build output (dist/). The postbuild guard (scripts/check-dist-forbidden-phrases.mjs) reads this file and fails the build if any phrase is found. Add new entries here — no code changes required. Use `ignore` (globs, relative to dist/) to skip files/folders globally; each phrase entry can also define its own `ignore` list.
